acceptance_criteria.criterion: all seven cells are dispatched and observed, none is not_started
the durable record confirms every cell
the positive multi path really creates workers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cell P1::A1-P: executed_worker_count == 3, multi_worker_execution is True, and the run's lifecycle evidence lists three distinct worker ids with the two wave-0 workers before the dependent one

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a worker is able to write, inside its own declared paths
acceptance_criteria.evidence: P1::A1-P tool-call evidence contains at least one file_write/file_edit by a worker, and no path outside that worker's owned_paths; the ownership guard is not assumed, it is read off the tool calls

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the artifact handoff reaches the downstream node
acceptance_criteria.evidence: P1::A1-P request evidence shows the 'integrate' request carrying both dependency outputs; if it does not, the run records HANDOFF_NOT_OBSERVED and this criterion fails

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the positive wave is observable as a wave
acceptance_criteria.evidence: two wave-0 workers with no dependency between them, both starting before 'integrate' starts. Wall-clock overlap is NOT observable (parallel_overlap_evidence is null); the canary records the wave structure and never reports an overlap number

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the selective arm refuses the negative task
acceptance_criteria.evidence: N1::A2-P: resolved_route == 'direct', executed_worker_count == 1, and the router audit carries SHARED_WRITE_RISK plus a blocked GATE_2_DEPENDENCY_COUPLING

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the selective arm admits the positive task
acceptance_criteria.evidence: P1::A2-P: resolved_route in {'delegate_parallel', 'delegate'} with executed_worker_count == 3, i.e. the router did not collapse a parallelisable plan

acceptance_criteria.criterion: worker usage is inside the run totals
acceptance_criteria.evidence: every cell records provider_prompt_tokens and its cache split status; the multi cells report several times the single cell's request count, and no field claims a per-agent token split the runtime does not measure
oracle_mode == 'sandbox' for all seven cells; each cell records oracle_passed next to the executor verdict, and no cell is reclassified because the two disagree
agent_sandbox_runs_confirmed_min == 7, confirmed_not_created == 0, unknown == 0, and no residual container is left on the endpoint

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the evidence is complete and outside the repository
acceptance_criteria.evidence: per-cell raw run directories plus a summary and an evidence index of byte lengths and SHA-256, held outside the checkout; the repository keeps only the sanitized aggregate

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the canary is never counted as a benchmark sample
acceptance_criteria.evidence: the summary and the published table carry canary_id and is_benchmark_sample == False; no canary row appears in the S11 aggregate

cannot_be_satisfied_by: protocol.APPROVAL_RECORD: it approves the benchmark definition, not an execution scope
the S06 authorization: a different stage, a different digest, already spent
any of the three formal plans: a different digest and a different cell list
authorization_template.granting_requires: a new commit that sets status=APPROVED with an approver, that commit's hash, a timestamp and exactly the digest above

expected.basis: measured 2026-11-18 per-cell usage, inherited where a cell was never run, x1.25 for multi cells

high.basis: the same tokens priced at a 0 % prompt-cache hit

proposed_stop.rule: 1.5x the HIGH estimate, rounded up to 5 cents; it must stay at or below 60 % of the nominal envelope

never_published: the raw container filesystem or a patch of the hidden fixtures
per_cell: cell_id, task_id, arm_id, topology, runner, prompt_layout, requested_route
resolved_route and reason codes, when the arm runs the router
estimated_cost_usd and its state, model_calls and their source
budget verdict, basis and admission rejections
sandbox creation status and destruction status
per_run: cell_count, execution_claim (attempt id, ledger path, CONSUMED)
cost_policy, cost ceiling state and breach flag
published: a sanitized aggregate built from the summary, never the raw workspace
an evidence index of byte lengths and SHA-256 for every published file
the sentence 'not a benchmark sample' next to every canary number

exclusions.formal_identity_note: the canary repeats the (cell, repetition 0) identities of formal r1. The formal plan still runs them: a canary result is never reused as a formal sample, and the formal r1 claim is a separate one-shot claim on a separate plan digest.
exclusions.statement: canary cells are structure evidence. They are excluded from the S11 aggregate even when they pass, because they are a single unreplicated observation of a path the formal matrix measures three times.

live_runnable_reason: the plan is wired and refused: pilot_authorization_gate rejects it because the record is pending, and no other approval in the repository names this digest
not_authorized: no model request is made by this module
no sandbox is created by this module
preparing the contract authorizes nothing: S08 stays closed until the record above is approved by the owner in its own commit
